title: Signal Identity Dump
description: Output shape of signal-identity-dump.sh. The same shape is written to current.json (latest) and <YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS>.json (archives). additionalProperties is permitted at every level because signal-cli is upstream and may add fields between releases.

self.description: Local Signal account identity. Base fields come from accounts.json; contact_record (when present) is the matching entry from listContacts, since signal-cli stores own profile there.

path.description: Path to this account's data dir under signal-cli storage

contact_record.description: Self entry from listContacts — present when a contact with uuid==self.uuid exists. Has the full Contact shape (see $defs.Contact).

contacts.description: All contacts known to the local account, including self.

contacts_count.description: Length of contacts. Mirrored at the top level for convenience.

groups.description: All groups the local account is a member of (or has been a member of and not removed).

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp from `now | todateiso8601` at dump time (UTC).

Contact.description: One entry from `signal-cli listContacts`. Most string fields are nullable because signal-cli emits explicit nulls for unset values.

number.description: E.164 number; null for contacts known only by UUID/username.

name.description: Display name as seen by us (may include profile or saved name).

messageExpirationTime.description: Per-contact disappearing-message expiry in seconds (0 = disabled).

profile.description: Decrypted profile data, when we have permission to fetch it.

Profile.description: Signal profile sub-object on a Contact. Fields populated by upstream profile fetch.

lastUpdateTimestamp.description: Epoch milliseconds when signal-cli last refreshed this profile.

Group.description: A Signal group as projected by signal-identity-dump.sh (renamed from signal-cli's raw shape; see the jq filter in the dumper).

id.description: Base64-encoded group master key (the same id used by openclaw.json's channels.signal.groups map).

active.description: Whether we are still a member of the group (sourced from isMember || active in the raw signal-cli output).

blocked.description: Group-level block state. Null when signal-cli didn't supply it.

group_invite_link.description: https://signal.group/... invite link, when one is set.

requesting_members.description: Awaiting admin approval (only present in admin-approval groups).

GroupMember.description: One member entry inside a Group.members / pending_members / etc. array.

number.description: E.164 number when known; null for UUID-only members.
